items.title: NASA AIT-GUI Flaws Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Issue Spacecraft Commands
items.summary:
Security researchers at Cycode have disclosed a chain of flaws in AIT-GUI, the browser-based operator console for NASA/JPL's open-source AMMOS Instrument Toolkit, that allow an unauthenticated attacker to issue arbitrary commands to the software's spacecraft and instrument command bus.

The chain, tracked as GHSA-p9r8-2q67-fp86 and rated 9.4 on the CVSS v3.1 scoring system, impacts AIT-GUI
items.author: info@thehackernews.com (The Hacker News)

items.title: ToxicPanda 2.0 and GoldDigger Expand Android Banking Attacks with On-Device Fraud
items.summary:
Cybersecurity researchers have shed light on an updated version of ToxicPanda (aka TgToxic) that comes with "significant enhancements," including a set of 167 remote commands and expands its targeting footprint globally.

Zimperium zLabs, in a Wednesday report, said the Android malware also features a PIN harvesting workflow targeting more than 140 banking and cryptocurrency applications.

items.title: 40 Malicious Firefox Extensions Pose as Web3 Products to Steal Wallet Secrets
